items.title: Computer Networking & Protocols: Wire-level packet communication, routing logic, and protocol stacks
items.content_text:
Deconstructing the OSI & TCP/IP models, analyzing packet lifecycles with Wireshark, socket-level communication, and DNS/routing topologies.

Architecture Focus: Layer 3/4 Packet Routing, Sockets & Protocol Analysis
Key Topics: Three-Way Handshake & Socket Lifecycle Management • Subnetting, CIDR, NAT, and Routing Tables • Wireshark Deep Packet Inspection & Stream Analysis • DNS Resolution & Recursive Query Architecture
Protocols: TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS 1.3, ICMP, OSI Layers

Code Implementation (bash):
ss -tulpn | grep -E ':(80|443|3000|5432)'
ip route show default
ping -c 4 -M do -s 1472 1.1.1.1
items.summary: Deconstructing the OSI & TCP/IP models, analyzing packet lifecycles with Wireshark, socket-level communication, and DNS/routing topologies.

items.title: Network Security & Cybersecurity: Threat modeling, access control, encryption, and defensive posture
items.content_text:
Studying defensive security paradigms, cryptographic standards, packet filtering, firewall configurations, and vulnerability assessments.

Architecture Focus: Zero-Trust Verification, Threat Modeling & Defensive Controls
Key Topics: Defensive Network Perimeter & Packet Filtering • Transport Layer Security (TLS) Handshake Decryption • API Security: Prevention of Injection, CSRF, and Broken Auth • Vulnerability Surface Scanning & Hardening
Protocols: SSL/TLS, Firewalls / iptables, PKI & Cryptography, OWASP Top 10, Access Control (RBAC)

Code Implementation (bash):
curl -sI https://yeasin-sec.vercel.app/api/health | grep -iE '(strict-transport|x-frame|content-security)'
openssl s_client -connect yeasin-sec.vercel.app:443 -tls1_3
items.summary: Studying defensive security paradigms, cryptographic standards, packet filtering, firewall configurations, and vulnerability assessments.

items.title: Linux Systems & Environment: Kernel primitives, daemon management, shell pipelines, and system internals
items.content_text:
Harnessing the Linux operating system as a development and server backbone through automation scripting, process inspection, and permission hardening.

Architecture Focus: POSIX Process Lifecycles, Daemons & Automated Pipelines
Key Topics: Linux Shell Automation & Pipeline Data Processing • System Services, Daemons & Log Diagnostics (journalctl) • File Permissions (chmod/chown), ACLs, and Sudoers • Process Lifecycle (kill, ps, top, htop, fork/exec)
Protocols: Bash / Shell Scripting, systemd, POSIX, SSH Hardening, Process Management, Cron

Code Implementation (bash):
sudo systemctl status backend-node.service
journalctl -u backend-node.service -f -n 50
ps aux --sort=-%mem | head -n 10
items.summary: Harnessing the Linux operating system as a development and server backbone through automation scripting, process inspection, and permission hardening.

items.title: [LAB-NET-01] Wireshark TCP Handshake & Packet Flow Dissection
items.content_text:
Capturing and analyzing SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK sequence numbers, window scaling, and connection termination (FIN/RST) across local and remote connections.

Domain: Protocol Analysis | Status: Documented
Tools: Wireshark, tcpdump, Raw Sockets, curl
Key Takeaway: Deepened practical understanding of transmission reliability, retransmissions, and TCP state machine transitions.

Lab Syntax & Commands (bash):
sudo tcpdump -i any -nn -v 'tcp[tcpflags] & (tcp-syn|tcp-ack|tcp-fin) != 0 and port 443' -c 10
items.summary: Capturing and analyzing SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK sequence numbers, window scaling, and connection termination (FIN/RST) across local and remote connections.

items.title: [LAB-SEC-02] REST API Authentication & Header Security Audit
items.content_text:
Evaluating backend endpoints against missing security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options), improper CORS policies, and token leakage.

Domain: Defensive Security | Status: Active Lab
Tools: Postman, Node.js, JWT Inspector, cURL
Key Takeaway: Standardized defensive header practices and token expiration lifecycles on backend microservices.

Lab Syntax & Commands (bash):
curl -i -X OPTIONS https://yeasin4745-dev.vercel.app/api/contact \
  -H "Origin: https://yeasin-sec.vercel.app" \
  -H "Access-Control-Request-Method: POST"
items.summary: Evaluating backend endpoints against missing security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options), improper CORS policies, and token leakage.

items.title: [LAB-SYS-03] Linux Server Hardening & SSH Key Enforcement
items.content_text:
Configuring non-root administrative users, enforcing Ed25519 SSH keys, disabling password authentication, and setting up basic UFW firewall rules.

Domain: System Hardening | Status: Active Lab
Tools: Ubuntu Server, SSH (Ed25519), UFW / iptables, systemd
Key Takeaway: Minimized attack surface on Linux hosts by restricting open ports and eliminating brute-force vectors.

Lab Syntax & Commands (bash):
sudo ufw default deny incoming
sudo ufw default allow outgoing
sudo ufw allow OpenSSH
sudo ufw enable && sudo ufw status verbose
items.summary: Configuring non-root administrative users, enforcing Ed25519 SSH keys, disabling password authentication, and setting up basic UFW firewall rules.

items.title: [LAB-NET-04] Subnet Topology & CIDR Allocation Planning
items.content_text:
Architecting multi-tier network topologies, isolating backend database subnets from public ingress, and calculating broadcast/network address boundaries.

Domain: Networking | Status: Planned Scenario
Tools: CIDR Calculators, Network Diagrams, Routing Tables
Key Takeaway: Clear principles for network segregation and defense-in-depth layout.

Lab Syntax & Commands (bash):
ip -br -c addr show
ip route show
items.summary: Architecting multi-tier network topologies, isolating backend database subnets from public ingress, and calculating broadcast/network address boundaries.

items.title: RFC 793 / RFC 9293: Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) Specification
items.content_text:
Studying state transition diagrams, sliding window algorithms, congestion window expansion, and socket teardown semantics.

Field: RFC & Protocol Study | Status: Deep Study
References: IETF RFC 9293, TCP/IP Illustrated Vol. 1

Reference Probe Syntax (bash):
ss -tin 'sport = :443 or dport = :443'
cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/tcp_wmem
items.summary: Studying state transition diagrams, sliding window algorithms, congestion window expansion, and socket teardown semantics.

items.title: RFC 9110: HTTP Semantics & Transport Evolution (HTTP/1.1 to HTTP/3)
items.content_text:
Analyzing stateless request-response mechanics, idempotency of methods, keep-alive connections, and QUIC over UDP.

Field: RFC & Protocol Study | Status: Deep Study
References: IETF RFC 9110, Cloudflare Learning Guides

Reference Probe Syntax (bash):
curl -Iv --http2 https://yeasin4745-dev.vercel.app/ -o /dev/null
items.summary: Analyzing stateless request-response mechanics, idempotency of methods, keep-alive connections, and QUIC over UDP.

items.title: Linux Process Architecture & Virtual File System (/proc, /sys)
items.content_text:
Investigating how the Linux kernel exposes runtime metrics via /proc, file descriptor management, standard streams, and signals.

Field: Linux Systems | Status: Deep Study
References: Linux Man Pages, The Linux Command Line

Reference Probe Syntax (bash):

ls -l /proc/self/fd/
items.summary: Investigating how the Linux kernel exposes runtime metrics via /proc, file descriptor management, standard streams, and signals.
